name: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector
author: shadowevor
description: Vortex extension for Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector (Steam / GOG). Adds game detection and a mod type for asset-replacement AND BepInEx runtime mods (deploys winhttp.dll + BepInEx/ + dotnet/ + asset files to the game root). Overwritten game files are backed up and restored automatically by Vortex on purge. Lists the Warpstorm Configurator as a Vortex tool when that mod is deployed.
